name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
accessNote: Bloodvelds here are close to Nieve, support a dwarf multicannon, and can be safespotted. Use a Slayer ring, Spirit tree to Tree Gnome Stronghold, or necklace of passage to Outpost. Hellhounds here are the primary non-Wilderness task option, with 13 spawns across four rooms of three or four Hellhounds, cannon support, and safespots.
